FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP.title: NP
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP.description: At [blue]100%[/blue]+ , you can use your [gold]Noble Phantasm[/gold].
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP_BAR.title: NP
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP_BAR.description:
1. When you play a non-[gold]Noble[/gold] card, gain [blue]{NpRate}%[/blue][gold]NP[/gold] per energy spent.
2. Gain [gold]NP[/gold] equal to attack damage taken.
3. At [blue]100%[/blue]+ , you can use your [gold]Noble Phantasm[/gold].
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_STAR.title: Critical Stars
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_STAR.description: At [blue]10[/blue]+ [gold]stars[/gold], your next attack deals double damage and consumes [blue]10[/blue] [gold]stars[/gold].
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_EXPLORATION.title: Exploration Point
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_EXPLORATION.descri: A resource gained in [gold]Imaginary Space[/gold]. [gold]Imaginary Breakout[/gold] consumes all Exploration Points, permanently increasing the [gold]NP[/gold] gained by [gold]Great Void Sea Battle[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue]% per point.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP_DAMAGE.title: NP Damage
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP_DAMAGE.descript: Increases [gold]NP[/gold] attack damage by this percentage.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_CRITICAL_DAMAGE.de: Increases [gold]Critical hit[/gold] damage by this percentage.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_EVIL_CURSE.title: Evil Curse
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_EVIL_CURSE.descrip: At the start of turn, lose HP equal to [gold]curse[/gold] stacks.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_COMMAND_SPELL.desc:
[gold]Noble Phantasm Release[/gold]: Gain [blue]100%[/blue] [gold]NP[/gold].
Activated by using [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Command Spell[/gold].

[gold]Spiritron Repair[/gold]: Restore [blue]30[/blue] HP.
Activated by using [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Command Spell[/gold].

[gold]Spiritron Restoration[/gold]: Survive fatal damage and restore all HP.
Gain [blue]300%[/blue] [gold]NP[/gold].
Activates when you are about to be defeated, consuming [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Command Spells[/gold].
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NOBLE.description: [gold]Noble Phantasm[/gold] has [gold]Retain[/gold] and is removed from the combat when played.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NOBLE.title: Noble Phantasm
FGO_CARDPILE_NOBLE.description:
Your [gold]Noble Deck[/gold].
Initially contains [gold]Beautiful Journey[/gold] and [gold]Camelot[/gold].
Right-click the [gold]Saint Quartz[/gold] relic to add more [gold]Noble[/gold] cards.
Cards are removed from this pile after being played.
FGO_CARDPILE_NOBLE.title: Noble Deck (N)
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FOREIGNER.title: Foreigner
Transform this card into [gold]Ray Proof of Hope Kyrielight[/gold], and transform [gold]Obscurant Wall of Chalk A[/gold] into [gold]Timeworn Bullet Kindling[/gold].
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_COOLDOWN.title: Cooldown
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_COOLDOWN.descripti: While this card is cooling down and in [blue]hand[/blue], playing any card reduces its Cooldown by [blue]1[/blue]. At [blue]0[/blue] it becomes playable, then re-enters Cooldown after being played.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_WATERSIDE.de:
[gold]Field[/gold]: At the start of your turn, [blue]ALL units[/blue] gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_BURNING.desc:
[gold]Field[/gold]: At the end of your turn, [blue]ALL units[/blue] take [blue]3[/blue] damage.
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_DARKNESS.des:
[gold]Field[/gold]: At the start of your turn, [blue]ALL units[/blue] gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Blind[/gold].
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_FOREST.title: Forest
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_FOREST.descr:
[gold]Field[/gold]: At the start of your turn, [blue]ALL units[/blue] gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold]. At the end of your turn, units below [blue]50%[/blue] HP gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Regeneration[/gold].
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_CITY.title: City
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_CITY.descrip:
[gold]Field[/gold]: Effect TBD (TODO).
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_SUNLIGHT.des:
[gold]Field[/gold]: When an Attack card is played, its player gains [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to the remaining stacks.
At the end of your turn, your [blue]allies[/blue] gain the same amount of [gold]Vigor[/gold].
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_FIELD_IMAGINARYSPA:
[gold]Field[/gold]: On entry, your hand is replaced by [gold]Route Planning[/gold], [gold]To the Surface, Nautilus[/gold] and [gold]Imaginary Breakout[/gold].
Loses [blue]1[/blue] stack at the start of each turn.
FGO_CARDPILE_VOIDHAND.title: Imaginary Scramble
FGO_CARDPILE_VOIDHAND.description: While in [gold]Imaginary Space[/gold], your hand is replaced by this pile.
